title: (fix) O3-4692: Display "Dispensed" status in Prescription Details section

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->
This PR implements the display of "Dispensed" status in the Prescription Details section to ensure consistency with other statuses like "Cancelled" and "Paused". Previously, the "Dispensed" status only appeared in the History and Comments section, which created an inconsistent user experience.
